responsibility: Declares the operand constraint language used by the RISC-V backend’s machine descriptions. It defines register classes, immediate classes, symbolic-address and memory constraints, and RVV-specific vector, mask, and constant-vector constraints, including vendor-extension-only register classes, so that patterns in riscv.md and related .md files can precisely describe which operands are legal for base ISA, compressed-friendly, CSR, PIC, vector, and vendor instructions.
